Do not submit vulnerabilities, credentials, invitations, real relay inventories
or unrelated traffic here. Read SECURITY.md for private reporting.

## Exact version and environment

Source commit or package version, operating system, architecture and profile.
Use synthetic or redacted configuration, without secrets or endpoint identities.

## Reproduction

Steps, expected result and actual result. Include the smallest safe example.

## Verification scope

State whether this was a local test, CI, installed-host check or field result.
List relevant checks and their results; retain failed evidence privately.
